mapper.select: SELECT d.disposal_id AS disposalId, d.disposal_unit AS disposalUnit, d.disposal_req_at AS disposalReqAt, d.disposal_app_at AS disposalAppAt, d.req_user_id AS reqUserId, d.disposal_status AS disposalStatus, d.processing_method AS processingMethod, d.disposal_type AS disposalType, d.disposal_reason AS disposalReason, d.disposal_detail_reason AS disposalDetailReason, d.reject_reason AS rejectReason, d.disposal_quantity AS disposalQuantity, d.disposal_price AS disposalPrice, d.order_detail_id AS orderDetailId FROM disposals d

SELECT d.disposal_id AS disposalId, d.disposal_unit AS disposalUnit, d.disposal_req_at AS disposalReqAt, d.disposal_app_at AS disposalAppAt, d.req_user_id AS reqUserId, d.disposal_status AS disposalStatus, d.processing_method AS processingMethod, d.disposal_type AS disposalType, d.disposal_reason AS disposalReason, d.disposal_detail_reason AS disposalDetailReason, d.reject_reason AS rejectReason, d.disposal_quantity AS disposalQuantity, d.disposal_price AS disposalPrice, d.order_detail_id AS orderDetailId FROM disposals d WHERE d.disposal_id = #{disposalId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO disposals (disposal_unit, disposal_req_at, req_user_id, disposal_status, processing_method, disposal_type, disposal_reason, disposal_detail_reason, disposal_quantity, disposal_price, order_detail_id) VALUES (#{disposalUnit}, #{disposalReqAt}, #{reqUserId}, #{disposalStatus}, #{processingMethod}, #{disposalType}, #{disposalReason}, #{disposalDetailReason}, #{disposalQuantity}, #{disposalPrice}, #{orderDetailId})
mapper.update: UPDATE disposals SET disposal_app_at = #{disposalAppAt}, disposal_status = #{disposalStatus}, reject_reason = CASE WHEN #{disposalStatus} = '거절' THEN #{rejectReason} ELSE NULL END WHERE disposal_id = #{disposalId} AND disposal_status = '요청'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM disposals WHERE disposal_id = #{disposalId} AND disposal_status = '요청'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disposals WHERE disposal_status IN ('승인', '완료') AND disposal_app_at >= CURDATE() AND CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY > disposal_app_at
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(disposal_price), 0) FROM disposals AS d WHERE disposal_status IN ('승인', '완료') AND disposal_app_at >= CURDATE() AND CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY > disposal_app_at

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disposals d, order_details od, orders o, stores s, disposal_app_infos dai WHERE d.order_detail_id = od.order_detail_id AND od.order_id = o.order_id AND o.store_id = s.store_id AND dai.disposal_id = d.disposal_id AND -- 폐기 확인정보가 기리키는 폐기 s.store_id = #{storeId} AND -- 직영점 일려번호와 d.disposal_status = '승인' AND (dai.check_at IS NULL OR -- 폐기 확인이 안된 경우 dai.check_user_id IS NULL OR -- 폐기 확인이 안된 경우 dai.disposal_img IS NULL) -- 폐기 확인이 안된 경우
